# Rule guide

## strict-fp-no-try

Prefer capture/captureAsync around the external operation. If it already returns Result, use captureResult/captureResultAsync. Keep real I/O in .b.ts. Do not mechanically rewrite try/finally cleanup.

```ts
import { captureAsync } from 'ts-calm/boundary';
const result = await captureAsync(() => readFile(path, 'utf8'), { name: 'read-config' });
```

## strict-fp-no-null

For absence use fromNullable/isNonNullable, then match, getOrElse or toResult. This preserves 0, false and ''. A protocol's real null value is different: keep its explicit boundary representation.

```ts
import { fromNullable, getOrElse } from 'ts-calm';
const name = getOrElse(fromNullable(externalName), () => 'anonymous');
```

## strict-fp-no-undefined

Convert external absence with fromNullable. Use at/lookup for possibly missing collection entries. Do not confuse an explicit stored value with an absent key.

```ts
import { lookup, match } from 'ts-calm';
const label = match(lookup(record, 'name'), {
  some: (value) => String(value),
  none: () => 'missing',
});
```

## strict-fp-no-any

Use unknown with isArray/isObject/isPlainObject/hasOwn, or a Decoder. A guard only proves its stated shape; property values still need checking.

```ts
import { hasOwn } from 'ts-calm';
const hasName = (value: unknown) => hasOwn(value, 'name') && typeof value.name === 'string';
```

## strict-fp-no-assertion

Prefer narrowing guards or a Decoder. Use branded only after validation. A necessary correlation assertion belongs in a narrowly documented adapter; as const is allowed.

```ts
import { isArray } from 'ts-calm';
const count = (value: unknown) => (isArray(value) ? value.length : 0);
```

## strict-fp-no-non-null

Use at/lookup and handle Option with match/getOrElse. get accepts only a known Ok/Some variant, not a possibly absent container.

```ts
import { at, getOrElse } from 'ts-calm';
const first = getOrElse(at(values, 0), () => fallback);
```

## strict-fp-no-throw

Return err for expected failures. Convert dependency exceptions with capture at the point where they enter your program.

```ts
import { err } from 'ts-calm';
const rejected = err({ code: 'invalid-input' });
```

## strict-fp-no-class

Represent data with readonly values and behavior with functions. Document unavoidable external class adaptation in .b.ts.

```ts
type Point = Readonly<{ x: number; y: number }>;
```

## strict-fp-no-this

Pass dependencies and state explicitly instead of relying on an implicit receiver.

```ts
const total = (value: Readonly<{ amount: number }>) => value.amount;
```

## strict-fp-no-with

Use explicit property access so names and dependencies remain visible.

```ts
const name = value.name;
```

## strict-fp-no-var

Use const; local let and ordinary loops are supported.

```ts
const value = calculate();
```

## strict-fp-no-delete

Construct a new value without the removed property instead of mutating shared input.

```ts
const { removed, ...remaining } = input;
```

## strict-fp-no-module-state

Pass state explicitly or create it inside the operation that owns its lifetime.

```ts
const createState = () => ({ count: 0 });
```

## no-file-cycles

Break file dependency cycles, including type-only edges; move genuinely shared definitions to an independent leaf.

```ts
a.ts -> shared.ts <- b.ts
```

## no-module-cycles

Each source directory is a module. A directory cycle can exist without any individual file cycle; inspect the reported witness imports.

```ts
orders/read.ts -> stock/types.ts
stock/write.ts -> orders/types.ts
```

## boundary

Only direct effects or concrete adaptation justify .b.ts. Explain the guarantee with @boundary, declare actual @effects, and prefer functional helpers before adding @allow.

```ts
/**
 * @boundary Read configuration as an explicit Result.
 * @effects node:fs/promises
 */
```

## function-length

Split by responsibility above 80 effective lines; above 150 is an error. A necessary local exception must remain used and state its reason.

```ts
// calm-allow-next-function function-length -- This dispatch mirrors one external format.
```

## commit-message

Use type(scope): description, ASCII throughout, with a subject no longer than 100 characters.

```ts
feat(fp): add safe guards
```
